2608.22131.title: TRACE: Artifact-Robust Statistical Shape Modeling from Imperfect Surface Scans - A Case Study in Craniosynostosis 3D Photography
2608.22131.paper_summary: Craniosynostosis severity analysis increasingly relies on statistical shape models (SSMs) to quantify cranial morphology, but most existing workflows depend on computed tomography or heavily curated three-dimensional (3D) photographs. Raw clinical 3D photographs provide a radiation-free and repeatable alternative, yet often contain shoulders, hands, hair, clothing, scanner noise, and incomplete boundaries that corrupt correspondences. We introduce the Template-constrained Robust Artifact-aware Correspondence Estimation (TRACE) framework, an unsupervised method for constructing SSMs directly from artifact-contaminated clinical 3D head photographs. TRACE predicts sparse anatomically corresponding head-surface control points from the raw point cloud, refines them through a coarse-to-fine Surface-Aware Deformation cascade, and uses thin-plate spline warping to deform a clean template mesh into a subject-specific head reconstruction. This template-constrained formulation keeps dense correspondences on clinically relevant head anatomy while suppressing non-head artifacts. The correspondence module is decoupled from the point-cloud encoder, enabling the same deformation pipeline to be paired with different backbones, including PointNet, DGCNN, and Point Transformer V3. Across all backbones, TRACE substantially improves surface sampling, topology preservation, and shape-model quality over prior SSM methods, providing a scalable foundation for photograph-based craniosynostosis shape analysis and a framework that may extend to other artifact-contaminated surface scans when an appropriate clean template is available.
2608.22131.paper_summary_zh: 顱縫早閉症的嚴重性分析越來越依賴統計形狀模型（SSMs）來量化顱骨形態，但大多數現有的工作流程依賴於計算機斷層掃描或經過精心整理的三維（3D）照片。原始的臨床3D照片提供了一種無輻射且可重複的替代方案，但通常包含肩膀、手、頭髮、衣物、掃描器噪聲和不完整的邊界，這些都會破壞對應關係。我們介紹了模板約束的穩健伪影感知對應估計（TRACE）框架，這是一種從受伪影污染的臨床3D頭部照片中直接構建SSMs的無監督方法。TRACE從原始點雲中預測稀疏的解剖對應頭部表面控制點，通過粗到細的表面感知變形級聯進行精煉，並使用薄板樣條變形將乾淨的模板網格變形為特定於主體的頭部重建。這種模板約束的公式在臨床相關的頭部解剖上保持密集的對應關係，同時抑制非頭部的伪影。對應模塊與點雲編碼器解耦，使得相同的變形管道可以與不同的骨幹配對，包括PointNet、DGCNN和Point Transformer V3。在所有骨幹中，TRACE顯著改善了表面採樣、拓撲保持和形狀模型質量，超越了之前的SSM方法，為基於照片的顱縫早閉症形狀分析提供了一個可擴展的基礎，並且這一框架可能擴展到其他受伪影污染的表面掃描，當有合適的乾淨模板可用時。
